set.body: Goal: add an idiomatic Scala 3 surface-mesh subsystem to ScalaFIM, using neurosurf as semantic reference but not as an S4/plotting port. Scope: cross-built core data structures, topology, vertex fields, ROI/set/bilateral containers, geodesic/neighborhood/parcel algorithms, JVM readers, docs, and parity fixtures. Non-goals: plotting widgets, RGL/Rvcg rendering, color-map rendering classes. Done when child beads cover module scaffold, core model, topology, fields, algorithms, IO, docs, and acceptance tests, and all implementation children are closed.
set.title: Epic: ScalaFIM surface mesh data structures
